content:
We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that reproduces the Still-Gennari reaction retrosynthetically. The description: forward reaction forms C-C double bond and carboxylic ester, breaks C-P, C-C, C-O, and changes alkyne triple bond to single bond. So target molecule likely is an alkene with ester? Input molecule not given directly. The available input data: from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-4 answer: '[]' meaning applying some template gave no precursors. We need to find template that when applied to the molecule reproduces the reaction. We need the molecule SMILES. Not provided directly. Maybe the molecule is given in previous tasks but not here. Could be the target is something like an alkyne? The Still-Gennari reaction: aldehyde + phosphonate ester -> (Z)-alkene ester. So product is an α,β-unsaturated ester (C=C and ester). So target SMILES maybe something like "C=CC(=O)O" which is acrylic acid (but that's acid not ester). Actually ester: maybe "C=CC(=O)OC" (methyl acrylate). The search we did used C=CC(=O)O (acrylic acid). Might be wrong.

We need to search templates that break C-P, C-C, C-O and change C≡C to C-C. So functional groups broken: maybe "phosphonate ester", "alkyne". Formed: "C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters". Use search criteria: functional_groups_broken include "phosphonate ester"? Not in list. Available functional groups list includes "carboxylic esters", "C-C double bonds", "C-C triple bonds". No phosphonate. Could use bonds broken/formed. We need to specify bonds broken: C-P, C-C, C-O, and bond order changed: C≡C to C-C (order changed). So bonds_broken: maybe "6-15"? Not sure. The tool expects bond types like "6-6". Not helpful.

Alternative: maybe we can retrieve template by searching for functional_groups_formed only gave empty. Could try functional_groups_broken include "C-C triple bonds".
